Bloodline.sum: Your bloodline gives you unique qualities

Contacts.sum: Mortals who provide information or items

Haven.sum: A place to sleep by day; V:tM, pp. 188–189. See Haven Merits and Haven Flaws.

Influence.sum: Influence and clout in the mortal community

Loresheets.sum: Information on or access to elements of deeper World of Darkness lore; V:tM, p. 190. See V:tM (pp. 382–406), Anarch (pp.190–198), Camarilla (pp. 184–190), and other Vampire books for specific loresheets.

Mask.sum: False identity; you can buy multiple Masks

Mawla.sum: Kindred patron, mentor, or other sometime ally; the plural of mawla is mawali

Retainers.sum: Loyal servant such as a ghoul or thrall; you can buy multiple Retainers

Status.sum: Status and rank in a sect of Kindred; V:tM, p. Merits

Beautiful.sum: Add one die to looks-dependent Social pools

Bond Resistance.sum: You resist Blood Bonds more easily

Check The Trunk.sum: Two-dice bonus to Preparedness dice pools (V:tM, p. 410)

City Secrets.sum: You know a damning secret about the city’s Kindred power structure

Cobbler.sum: You can make Masks, requires Mask ••

Famous Face.sum: You resemble someone very well known

High-Functioning Addict.sum: You add a die to one pool type while on your drug

Ingénue.sum: Add two dice to rolls to avoid suspicion

Iron Gullet.sum: You can feed on cold blood. Not available to Ventrue

Luck Of The Devil.sum: Others take the fall for your fuckups

Nuit Mode.sum: Your body can keep tattoos, haircuts, etc. Not available over Blood Potency 1

Remarkable Feature.sum: Add two dice to Social rolls with strangers, lose one die from disguise pools

Short Bond.sum: Blood Bond on you decays more rapidly

Side Hustler.sum: Once per session, get something as if you had two dots in Resources, Contacts, or Influence through your network.

Stunning.sum: Add two dice to looks-dependent Social pools

Tempered Will.sum: Add a die to resist Dominate or Presence. May not have dots in either Discipline

Untouchable.sum: Escape official punishment once per story

Vessel Recognition.sum: You can smell whether a mortal has been fed upon

Zeroed.sum: You officially don’t exist. Requires Mask •• ; V:tM, p. 192. Haven Merits Unless noted, Haven Merits appear in V:tM (p. 189).

Business Establishment.sum: Renting to (or running) a business out of your haven at the cost of some privacy

Furcus.sum: Adds dice to Rituals or Ceremonies (pick one)

Library.sum: Only one dot allowed in Haven •

Machine Shop.sum: Adds dice to Craft, repair, etc. pools

Watchmen.sum: Guards. Caitiff Merits These Merits only apply to Caitiff characters. They appear on

Death-Proof.sum: Cannot learn Oblivion, but immune to it.

Favored Blood.sum: Can buy powers from any Discipline as in-clan, needing only one prerequisite power for amalgams.

Mark Of Caine.sum: Two phantom dots of Status for bullying and intimidating other Kindred, harder to diablerize.

Mockingbird.sum: Can drink Discipline powers from other vampires.

Uncle Fangs.sum: Thin-blood ally group. Ghoul Merits These Merits only apply to ghoul characters. They appear on

Blood Empathy.sum: Can sense your domitor’s emotional state at a distance.

Unseemly Aura.sum: Your Aura resembles a Kindred aura. Thin-Blood Merits These Merits only apply to thin-blood characters. They have no dot value; each Flaw balances a Merit, and vice versa. Thin-Blood Merits appear in V:tM (pp. 183-184) and on

Abhorrent Blood.sum: Other Kindred cannot drink your blood

Catenating Blood.sum: You can create Blood Bonds and Embrace.

Discipline Affinity.sum: Gain a dot in a Discipline, as a normal vampire.

Lifelike.sum: Medically mortal; you can eat, drink, fuck, etc.

Low Appetite.sum: Roll two dice on some Rouse Checks

Lucid Dreamer.sum: You dream and can remember relevant details; p.

Swift Feeder.sum: Slake one Hunger in one turn including closing wounds

Thin-Blood Alchemist.sum: You can take Thin-Blood Alchemy as a Discipline.

Vampiric Resilience.sum: You take damage as a regular vampire. Flaws

Addiction.sum: Lose one die without a fix

Archaic.sum: Cannot use technology. Ancillae or older only

Bond Junkie.sum: Harder to resist the Blood Bond

Dark Secret.sum: If found out, you would be infamous and hunted

Despised.sum: One group or region of the city despises you

Folkloric Bane.sum: A folkloric bane (e.g., silver, holy water) causes you Aggravated damage

Folkloric Block.sum: Must spend Willpower to push through a folkloric block (e.g., spilled seeds, running water, holy symbols)

Hopeless Addiction.sum: Lose two dice without a fix

Knowledge Hungry.sum: Must make a Willpower roll to resist studying your obsession

Living In The Past.sum: Outmoded Convictions cause Social penalties. Ancillae or older only

Long Bond.sum: Blood Bond on you decays more slowly

Methuselah’s Thirst.sum: You can only fully slake Hunger with supernatural blood

Obvious Predator.sum: You frighten mortals and cannot maintain a Herd

Organovore.sum: You can only feed on human organs

Prey Exclusion.sum: You refuse to hunt specific prey

Repulsive.sum: Lose two dice from looks-dependent Social pools

Risk-Taker.sum: Compulsive risk-taker, two dice penalty when resisting risky behavior

Stake Bait.sum: Stakes to the heart cause the Final Death

Starving Decay.sum: At Hunger 3+ your body decays for a two-dice penalty to physical tests and to social tests with mortals

Stench.sum: Lose one die from relevant Social pools, two dice from relevant Stealth pools

Stigmata.sum: You bleed from hands and feet at Hunger 4

Suspect.sum: Two-dice Social penalties with the vampire sect

Transparent.sum: One-die penalty to Subterfuge. Cannot gain dots in Subterfuge

Twice-Cursed.sum: Take your clan’s variant Bane (p. 56) in addition to your regular Bane

Ugly.sum: Lose one die from looks-dependent Social pools

Vegan.sum: You only feed on animal blood

Vein Tapper.sum: You cannot take blood from mortals while being observed

Weak-Willed.sum: One-die penalty to social combat against a superior, you may not use active resistance against Dominate or Presence; p. 121. Haven Flaws

Liquidator.sum: Considered an enemy to thin-bloods, two-dice penalty to social pools with them.

Muddled Blood.sum: Must drink Blood of someone with a Discipline to buy dots in it.

Walking Omen.sum: Scrying, premonitions, divination point to you as the cause of misfortune.

Word-Scarred.sum: Skin covered with vampire lore texts, making you an occult target. Ghoul Flaws These Flaws only apply to ghoul characters. They appear on

Baneful Blood.sum: You suffer from your domitor’s clan Bane.

Crone’s Curse.sum: The Blood aged and weakened you, lose one Health box.

Distressing Fangs.sum: Lose one die on Social pools with mortals. Thin-Blood Flaws These Flaws only apply to thin-blood characters. They have no dot value; each Flaw balances a Merit, and vice versa. Thin-Blood Flaws appear in V:tM (pp. 182–183) and on

Twilight Presence.sum: You make mortals and full-bloods uneasy

Unending Hunger.sum: Resist hunger frenzy when you feed
